content:
We got search results, list of templates. Need the one that corresponds to Friedel-Crafts acylation. The description: "The Friedel-Crafts acylation ... halide functional group is gone". The template likely breaks a C–Cl bond and forms C–C bond to aromatic. Look at returned templates:

1st entry reaction_id 503959: retro_smarts_template looks complex, not simple.

2nd entry reaction_id 913001: seems not.

3rd entry reaction_id 1050813: retro_smarts_template: '[#7:6]-[c;H0;D3;+0:5](:[cH;D2;+0:1]:[c:2]):[cH;D2;+0:3]:[c:4]>>Br-c(:[cH;D2;+0:1]:[c:2]):[cH;D2;+0:3]:[c:4].O=[CH;D2;+0:5]-[#7:6]'. This is a bromination? It breaks C-Br and forms amide? Not.

4th entry reaction_id 761427: also not.

The Friedel-Crafts acylation template likely has a halide (Cl) on aromatic ring and an acyl chloride as reagent. The retro template would break C–Cl bond and produce acyl chloride and aromatic ring. The template may have pattern like '[c:1]-Cl>>[c:1]-C(=O)Cl' etc.

None of the returned templates look like that. Maybe the search criteria were too specific. Could try search without bonds criteria, just functional_groups_broken halide.
Let's search again with only halide broken.
